name: Python venv + Node env + dependency files
outputs: requirements.txt, frontend/package.json, run.bat/run.sh scripts

outputs: data/processed/projects_clean.csv, docs/data_quality_report.md
definition_of_done: Clean CSV generated idempotently; DQ checks passed/documented; <5% critical nulls.

name: Centroid reference table
outputs: data/reference/centroids.csv
definition_of_done: >=90% districts matched with centroids; otherwise map feature demoted.

name: Schema + load DB
outputs: SQLite DB (mplads.db), scripts/build_db.py, docs/contracts/db_contract.md
definition_of_done: Row counts match clean CSV; FK integrity queries pass; contract doc committed and frozen.

name: FastAPI skeleton + CORS + error handlers
outputs: backend/app/main.py, /health route, CORS middleware, global exception handler
definition_of_done: FastAPI app runs, Swagger docs load at /docs, 404/422 structured error responses verified.

name: ORM models + Pydantic schemas (frozen)
outputs: backend/app/models.py, backend/app/schemas.py, docs/contracts/api_contract.md
definition_of_done: Round-trip DB <-> model <-> schema tests pass; contracts declared frozen.

name: Endpoints: overview, projects, project/{id}
outputs: GET /api/stats/overview, GET /api/projects, GET /api/projects/{id} routes
definition_of_done: Pytest contract tests pass; pagination, sorting, filtering verified.

name: Cohort statistics script
outputs: ml/cohort_stats.py, stats tables / JSON
definition_of_done: Cohort medians and P90 values computed; spot-checked by hand against 5 cohorts.

name: risk_engine.py (pure functions)
outputs: ml/risk_engine.py with deterministic anomaly scoring rules
definition_of_done: Unit tests pass on edge cases and hand-verified fixture records; pure deterministic logic.

name: Batch scoring -> risk tables
outputs: Populated risk_scores and risk_flags tables in SQLite
definition_of_done: Batch execution completes; overall flag rate sits in 1-6% band; 1 project manually verified end-to-end.

name: Endpoints: anomalies, analyticsx2, locations, methodology, CSV
inputs: Frozen API contract, populated risk tables
outputs: GET /api/anomalies, /api/analytics/*, /api/locations, /api/methodology, /api/reports/risk-summary.csv
definition_of_done: Contract tests pass; CSV export validates in spreadsheet software.

name: React foundation: router, theme, API client, states
outputs: frontend shell, Vite setup, Tailwind/CSS tokens, React Router, apiClient, loading/error boundary states
definition_of_done: All route placeholders render; mock-driven client verified; government palette applied.

outputs: Overview/Home page, Dashboard page with KPIs and Recharts visualizations
definition_of_done: 4 KPI metric cards + charts render live data seamlessly.

name: Project Explorer
outputs: Project Explorer page with filters, search, sort, and pagination
definition_of_done: Search/filter/sort/pagination live and reactive with zero console errors.

name: Anomaly Review Queue
outputs: Anomaly table with risk badges, filter chips, reason tags, export button
definition_of_done: Anomaly table renders all flagged projects; filters update dynamically.

name: Project Deep Investigation
outputs: Project detail page with score gauge, reason cards, peer comparable table, timeline
definition_of_done: Detail page displays correctly for any valid project ID; zero mock/fabricated data.

name: Map page
outputs: Geographic Intelligence Map page
definition_of_done: District centroids and markers render color-coded by risk; fallback view handled.

name: Integration pass
outputs: End-to-end verified application without mock fallbacks
definition_of_done: Zero console errors; full user journey clicks functional; contract conformance verified.

name: Full test suite + E2E
outputs: pytest test suite, frontend component/E2E test runs, QA report
definition_of_done: All P0 unit, integration, and contract tests pass green.

name: Security review
outputs: docs/security_review.md
definition_of_done: Risk table complete; no hardcoded secrets; read-only guarantees verified.

name: Deploy frontend + backend runbook
outputs: docs/deployment_runbook.md, Vercel frontend config, localhost runbook
definition_of_done: Localhost production runbook verified; Vercel deployment instructions validated.
